about_short_description.short_description: Opennote is an edtech company that offers an AI-powered platform for interactive learning experiences.

product.name: Feynman-2
product.description: An AI-powered educational agent that provides interactive, multimodal learning experiences including problem-solving, video lessons, and visualizations tailored to student progress.

product.name: DeepTutor
product.description: An AI research agent that uses recursive web search and inference to provide detailed, accurate educational responses across diverse subjects and difficulty levels.

product.name: Feynman
product.description: An AI educational inference system that generates interactive, multimodal content including text-to-video, code execution, and graph interaction to support personalized learning.

product.name: Opennote Learning Toolkit
product.description: A customizable platform combining videos, whiteboards, graphs, practice problems, and web search to create interactive learning environments.
